levels.label: Explainable finding
levels.allowed_claim: The case starts from a bounded rule finding with an explicit risk and fixture.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every finding is automatically correct or ready for repair.

levels.label: Counterexample-safe comparison
levels.allowed_claim: The canonical rule and isolated draft produce the same expected match/no-match outcomes in the W2 suite.
levels.forbidden_inference: The draft is universally safe or has passed every possible fixture.

levels.label: Target-bound receipt
levels.allowed_claim: A local receipt records the target revision, engine version, and fresh verification result.
levels.forbidden_inference: The receipt is a hosted or externally accepted release artifact.

levels.label: Producer and IDE handoff
levels.status_display: Cross-producer and direct IDE proof pending
levels.allowed_claim: The repository documents seams for Evidence Replay and a read-only VS Code projection.
levels.forbidden_inference: A direct IDE readback or downstream receipt handoff has passed.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The Rule Lab case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
